name: Rhys Davies
bio:
Rhys joined Lechner Racing with a clear vision: to build a team as competitive off the track as it is on it. Having studied Human Resource Management at Cardiff University, he quickly developed a passion for motorsports, seeing the potential to bring innovative HR strategies to a fast-paced environment. He believes in creating a supportive and challenging workplace, where every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best.

His approach to HR is data-driven, focusing on performance metrics and employee development programs tailored to the unique needs of a motorsport team. Rhys is dedicated to fostering a culture of continuous improvement and open communication, ensuring that Lechner Racing attracts and retains top talent. He's not afraid to make tough decisions, driven by a desire to see the team succeed on and off the track.

Rhys distinguishes himself with his commitment to ensuring fairness and equal opportunity within the team. He is also a keen advocate for mental well-being, organizing workshops and training sessions to help team members manage the pressures of racing. This holistic approach makes him a valuable asset to Lechner Racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part
physical.description: Rhys is of average height with a lean build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Insists on having a perfectly organized desk, even on race weekends.
Uses motorsport analogies in everyday conversations.
